title: Search Performance Optimization — P95 Latency < 200ms
description:
Customer-facing search performance improvement initiative. Current state: P95 latency 210ms (improved from 380ms baseline). Target: P95 < 200ms.

Completed optimizations:
1. Added GIN index on documents.content for full-text search (PR #48)
2. Implemented query result caching with 60s TTL (PR #49)
3. Rebuilt documents.created_at index after NEX-244 incident (PR #52)

Remaining work: Connection pool tuning, query plan analysis for edge case queries.

See docs/search-optimization-plan.md for detailed approach.
